text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Should this be enough
snacks, I wonder?
Next is the juice—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
...That is quite a lot of shopping,
isn't it—Chrono-san?

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bouquet-san!?
Ah, th-this is...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, you see... um...
I just really felt like eating snacks...
J-Just kidding...!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? If that's the case—
let me help you carry them.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you very much.
I'm so sorry for making you help me out...!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
(...Such a kind person, as always...
Still, thank goodness she didn't realize...)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, should this be enough paper ring garlands?
About one-hundredth of a mile's worth!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Placing the plates around here should be fine.
Let's line up the food over this way~♪"

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
In that case—it might be good
to prepare paper napkins as well.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah"...!?
...Bou...
"Bouquet-san!? Why are you here!?"

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Ah... E-Excuse me. Everyone
looked so busy preparing, so...

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
...Is there a party today...?
Just earlier, Chrono-san was buying a lot of snacks too—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
If you are celebrating someone,
by all means, please allow me to help.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, well, you seee~...
We appreciate the help, but...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's a surprise party, or rather...
the details are top secret.
...Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
...?
Y-Yes... I understand.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
And so—in flower arrangement,
pairing contrasting colors makes it vivid—
creating an impression perfectly suited for a special day.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "I see~!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
This side is done!
Where should we decorate it!?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Since we chose flowers with subtle
fragrances for that one, placing it on the dining table—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. In the end, everyone was bound together
by Bouquet-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Still, you know.
It's precisely because Bouquet-chan is like that—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
...With this, preparations are complete.
It will surely be a wonderful party
...I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Fufu.
I'm truly glad too.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"...Today's party...
The truth is... the one being celebrated is..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Bouquet-san!
It's youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Eh...
M-Me? Wh-Why...!?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Because! Bouquet-san, you're always
so kind to everyone...
and truly such a sweet person!"

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
We decided to hold a surprise party
to express our gratitude! Thank goodness...
it turned out to be a real surprise...!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Th-That can't be... for me...
I-I'm not worthy of such honor...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, modest as ever.
...But you see, just for today, we need Bouquet-chan
to be in the center.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, it wouldn't become a harmonious, beautiful "bouquet"
...at least, that's what I think.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
...I understand.
Everyone... truly, thank you so much.

And so, a wonderful party was held,
one that would be talked about fondly for years to come.
